result.generation_response: VAMED IVI Cinolenton Charter 2014-15 Budget Summary: Total revenue of $5,461,160 comprises state/local per-pupil funding ($4,346,160), Title I/II/IDEA grants ($805,000), and donations ($50,000). Major expenditures include: Salaries ($2,709,910 for 27 teachers, 5 paras, specialists, and administrative staff); Employee Benefits ($668,712); Purchased Professional Services ($271,609); Purchased Property Services ($995,359 for utilities, repairs, maintenance); and Other Purchased Services ($640,475 for transportation, insurance, food service).

James M. Singleton Charter School's 2014-15 budget includes supplies (Object Code 600) totaling $95,095.43, covering materials, food, books, and custodial supplies. Other uses of funds (Object Code 900) include depreciation ($15,000), indirect costs ($65,000), and contingency ($80,000), with total expenditures reaching $5,461,160.00.

James Singleton Charter School's 2012-2013 budget assumes 520 MFP and 40 LA4 students, with MFP funding at $8,358 per pupil and LA4 at $5,532.50 per pupil. The teacher-to-student ratio is 22:1, the school calendar includes 182-192 instructional days, and federal funds (Title I, II, IDEA B) are projected at $805,000, representing 90% of the 2013-14 allocation pending BESE approval.
